AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details about the access denial. This field is returned only when a RAM permission verification fails
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 访问被拒绝详细信息，只有RAM校验失败才会返回此字段

Code.description_en:
The request status code.

OK indicates that the request was successful.

For other error codes, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196974.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。

返回OK代表请求成功。

其他错误码，请参见[错误码列表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196974.html）

Data.description_en: The result details of the monitoring task

Message.description_en: The success message returned when the call succeeds, or the error message returned when the call fails
Message.description_zh: 调用成功时返回成功信息，调用失败时返回出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The ID of this request, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use it to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
